t: AWS Key Management Service now supports ML-KEM for post-quantum key encapsulation
x: AWS KMS now supports ML-KEM (NIST FIPS 203) with ML-KEM-512, 768 and 1024 key specs, with private keys protected in FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSMs.

t: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports cross-Region trusted identity propagation
x: Trusted identity propagation now carries the user's identity to AWS services in other Regions, keeping per-user access control and auditing.

t: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports OAuth for Apache Iceberg REST Catalog APIs
x: Iceberg REST Catalog APIs accept OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens obtained by exchanging an OIDC token, so partners query tables without AWS credentials; IAM and Lake Formation still govern access.

t: AWS IAM Identity Center's Identity Store now supports change notifications through Amazon EventBridge
x: Identity Store sends EventBridge events when users, groups, group memberships or the identity store are created, updated or deleted.

t: AWS Agent Registry is now available in four additional AWS Regions
x: AWS Agent Registry adds London, Frankfurt, Ohio and Canada (Central), reaching nine Regions.

t: Quick now supports smart approvals for agentic actions
x: Smart approvals adds a review layer that cuts unnecessary approval prompts while keeping human oversight of the agent actions that matter most.

t: Amazon EKS Dashboard now provides fleet-wide visibility into certificate authority (CA) rotation
x: The Amazon EKS Dashboard now gives a consolidated view of certificate authority rotation across clusters, Regions and accounts.

t: AWS Backup adds restore testing support for Amazon Redshift
x: AWS Backup restore testing now covers Amazon Redshift, confirming backups restore successfully and measuring restore time.

t: Amazon Aurora now supports post-quantum TLS key exchange
x: Aurora PostgreSQL 18 and higher lets you set the ssl_groups parameter to select post-quantum TLS key exchange groups for data in transit.

t: ACM now supports ACME for public certificates in AWS GovCloud (US)
x: ACM ACME support reaches AWS GovCloud (US-East) and (US-West), automating public certificate issuance and renewal with ACMEv2 clients.

t: AWS Backup now supports cross-account management and cross-account backup in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud
x: Cross-account management, cross-account backup and delegated administrators are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region.

t: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports custom designations
x: Custom designations are named permission sets that administrators assign to project members for separation of duties, up to 10 per domain.

t: AWS Step Functions workflows now available as AI agent tools
x: Agents call Step Functions workflows as tools through AgentCore Gateway, and each step runs exactly as defined.

t: AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions
x: CloudFront adds the AWS WAF JavaScript SDK script tag to served HTML, supplying client signals for Bot Control targeted, ATP and ACFP with no code change.

t: Amazon MSK now supports TLS 1.3 for data in transit
x: MSK Provisioned clusters accept TLS 1.3 through named security policies, including mixed TLS 1.2 and 1.3 policies and TLS 1.3 only policies.

t: Amazon CloudFront now provides viewer ISP and post-quantum TLS details
x: CloudFront can forward the CloudFront-Viewer-ISP and CloudFront-Viewer-TLS-Details headers, showing whether each viewer connection used post-quantum cryptography.

t: Daybreak Red from OpenAI now available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
x: Daybreak Red (GPT-5.6 Cyber), built for authorized vulnerability research, is available to enrolled customers in US East (Ohio) and AWS GovCloud (US-East).
